name: Put-in-Bay (United States)
description: Burgee-shaped like the Ohio flag: a blue sky with a yellow sun and moon over green land and a blue bay, charged with the white letters P and B flanking Perry's Victory monument, with grapevines, the brig Niagara and EST. 1877.
history: Put-in-Bay is a resort village located on South Bass Island in Ottawa County, Ohio. The flag was adopted in 2012 (the winning design of Robert M. Kansa, posted in October 2012, according to Flags of the World).
